name: realistic-macro-earring-texture
image_purpose: UGC-style product and material detail visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic macro detail photograph of a circular metallic earring worn on an adult ear.
prompt.main_subject: Close detail of an original approved adult person's ear wearing a circular silver metallic hoop earring. Preserve the earring's reflective surface, natural specular highlights, faint fingerprints, fine pores, subtle peach fuzz, and realistic earlobe texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Tight macro crop of the ear and hoop, dark hair softly blurred behind, earring centered as the primary product detail, subtle shadow beneath the ring and clean uncluttered background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused daylight from a nearby window at approximately 5400K, top-left direction, natural highlight rolloff, neutral daylight color balance, realistic reflective metal.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic 90mm macro lens, f/4, 1:2 magnification, shallow depth of field, sharp metal and skin texture, natural sensor grain, no artificial HDR look or excessive sharpening.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic macro photograph of an original approved adult person's ear wearing a circular silver metallic hoop earring. The reflective earring shows natural specular highlights and faint fingerprints; fine pores, subtle peach fuzz, and realistic earlobe texture remain visible. Dark hair forms soft background bokeh. Soft diffused window daylight from top-left at approximately 5400K creates natural highlight rolloff and a subtle shadow beneath the ring. 90mm macro lens, f/4, 1:2 magnification, neutral daylight color, natural sensor grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, excessive sharpening, distorted jewelry, deformed anatomy

assets.name: silver hoop macro reference
assets.usage: Match the adult ear, hoop shape, metal finish, hair bokeh, macro crop, and window-light direction.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the adult-safe crop, earring shape, metal finish, skin texture, background hair, and lighting. Jewelry branding, product marks, typography, and background details are replaceable editable elements.
